cmd.start.subscriber: 👋 Welcome! This bot manages your access to {channel}. Pick a plan to get in — access is granted the moment your payment clears.
cmd.start.owner: 👋 Welcome back, {name}. You are managing {channels} channel(s) and {members} active member(s).
cmd.start.new:
👋 Welcome!

I run paid subscriptions for private Telegram channels — payments, invites, renewals and removals, all automatic.

Use /setup to connect your first channel. Your first {trial_days} days are free.
plan.list.title: Available plans for {channel}:
plan.none: This channel has no active plans yet.
checkout.title: 🧾 {plan} Channel: {channel} Price: {price} Duration: {days} days
checkout.manual_card: Transfer exactly {amount} to: {card} {holder} ⚠️ The amount must match to the last digit — that is how the payment is identified. Then tap “I have paid”.
checkout.paypal: Pay {price} via PayPal to: {paypal} {link} Then tap “I have paid” and we will confirm shortly.
checkout.awaiting: ⏳ Thanks. Your payment is awaiting confirmation. You will get your invite link as soon as it clears.
payment.confirmed: ✅ Payment confirmed! Here is your personal invite link to {channel}: {link} ⚠️ It works once and only for you. Your access runs until {expires}.
payment.failed: ❌ That payment could not be confirmed. Nothing was charged. Please try again or contact the channel owner.
sub.reminder: ⏰ Your access to {channel} ends in {days} day(s), on {expires}. Renew now to keep it without interruption.
sub.grace: ⚠️ Your subscription to {channel} has expired. You keep access for {days} more day(s). Renew to avoid being removed.
sub.expired: 🚫 Your access to {channel} has ended and you have been removed. You can resubscribe any time.
owner.setup.intro: Let's connect a channel. 1. Add this bot to your private channel 2. Make it an admin with “Invite users via link” and “Ban users” permissions 3. Forward any message from that channel here
owner.setup.not_admin: ❌ I am not an admin in that channel, or I am missing the “Invite users” / “Ban users” permission. Fix that and forward a message again.
owner.setup.done: ✅ {channel} is connected. Now add a plan with /addplan.
owner.plan.ask_title: What should this plan be called? (e.g. “Monthly”)
owner.plan.ask_days: How many days does it last?
owner.plan.ask_price: What is the price? Send a number only.
owner.stats: 📊 {channel} Active members: {active} Expiring in 7 days: {expiring} Revenue this period: {revenue} Renewal rate: {renewal_rate}%
owner.provider.pick: How do you want to collect payments?
billing.invoice: 🧾 Invoice for the next {days} days. Transfer exactly {amount} to: {card} {holder} ⚠️ The amount must match to the last digit. Then tap “I have paid”.
billing.trial: 🎁 You are on a free trial until {expires}.
billing.past_due: ⚠️ Your plan expired on {expires}. Your channels keep running for now, but new signups are paused until you renew.
referral.info: 🎁 Invite other channel owners Your link: {link} For every owner who joins and subscribes, you get {reward} off your own bill. Invited so far: {count}
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.not_owner: This action is only available to channel owners.
